counterfactual_missing_items: orange-red scaling with islands of sparing (PRP feature)
specific trichoscopic finding of invagination is not linked to psoriasis
decisive_items: widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
Skin biopsy: Showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
response.rationale: R1 directly matches the core skin findings (double-edged scale, psoriasiform hyperplasia) and biopsy, while R2 shares the same skin and biopsy spans but lacks a distinctive PRP feature; R4 only addresses hair findings and ignores the dominant skin presentation. C1 is an append-only completion of R1 without additional raw support.

rejected.why: Only supports hair abnormalities, which are secondary and not the primary diagnostic clue; ignores the widespread skin plaques and biopsy.
Append-only completion of R1 with no independent raw support; adds a histological subtype but does not change the diagnosis.
